description: Add a Contact link to the navigation bar

userStories.title: Add Contact link to Navbar component
userStories.description: As a user, I want to navigate to the Contact page via the navigation bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Navbar includes a <Link to="/contact">Contact</Link> element after existing links
The Contact link has the same margin, font, and styling as other navigation links
Link is functional and routes to the Contact page without errors
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
